observed_regression.behavior_before: ClerkTokenVerifier rejected every otherwise-valid session token whose optional sts claim was absent because claims.get('sts') had to equal 'active'.
observed_regression.upstream_observation: Clerk documents sts as an optional session-status check used to reject pending organization sessions; published authenticated-session examples omit sts.

candidate_fix.law: absent sts is admitted after normal JWT/signature/time/issuer/authorized-party/session/subject verification; explicit active is admitted; any explicitly non-active sts remains fail-closed; impersonated act remains rejected

isolated_mechanism_evidence.signed_rs256_harness: PASS: sts absent + active admitted; pending/ended/abandoned/empty and impersonation rejected
